:::{#exr-prediction-error-residual}
#### Prediction error and residual of a fitted observation

For an observation $i$ that was used to fit the model,
write its [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) $\prederr_i$
in terms of its [residual](#def-residual) $\resid_i$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-prediction-error-residual}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\prederr_i
&= \fitted_i - y_i
&& \text{(definition of prediction error)}\\
&= -(y_i - \fitted_i)
&& \text{(factor out $-1$)}\\
&= -\resid_i
&& \text{(definition of residual)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
